title: To‘liq mock imtihon: Writing va Reading
goal_uz: Dars oxirida siz ikki yozma topshiriqni belgilangan vaqtda rejalab yozasiz, o‘qishning eng qiyin uch savol turini strategiya bilan yechasiz, ishingizni to‘rt mezon bo‘yicha o‘zingiz baholaysiz va natijalarga asoslangan sonli rivojlanish rejasini tuzasiz.

scenes.title: Yozish va o‘qish mock imtihoni
board: Full Mock Exam: Writing & Reading
(To‘liq mock imtihon: yozish va o‘qish)
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda to‘liq gapirish imtihonini topshirdik, o‘zimizni baholadik va sonli reja tuzdik. Bugun xuddi shu yo‘lni yozish va o‘qishda bosib o‘tamiz. Dars oxirida siz ikki yozma topshiriqni vaqt ichida bajarasiz, o‘qishning eng qiyin savol turlarini yechasiz, ishingizni mezonlar bo‘yicha baholaysiz va natijaga asoslangan reja tuzasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back. Last time you spoke under pressure; today you write and read under pressure. Have a timer, paper and a pen ready.
scenes.say_uz: Xush kelibsiz. O‘tgan safar bosim ostida gapirdingiz, bugun bosim ostida yozasiz va o‘qiysiz. Taymer, qog‘oz va ruchkani tayyorlab qo‘ying.

scenes.title: Mock tuzilishi
board: Writing: 90 min
Task 1: essay, 240–280 words  |  Task 2: article/report/review, 280–320 words
Reading: 60 min — gapped text, inference, cross-text matching
scenes.say_native: Bizning mock imtihon ikki qismdan iborat. Yozish uchun to‘qson daqiqa: birinchi topshiriq ikki qisqa matn asosida esse, ikki yuz qirqdan ikki yuz saksongacha so‘z; ikkinchisi maqola, hisobot yoki taqriz, ikki yuz saksondan uch yuz yigirmagacha so‘z. O‘qish uchun oltmish daqiqa va unda eng qiyin uch savol turi bor. Haqiqiy imtihondagidek lug‘at, telefon va tanaffus yo‘q.
scenes.say: Ninety minutes for two writing tasks, sixty minutes for reading. No dictionary, no phone, no breaks: exactly as on the day.
scenes.say_uz: Ikki yozma topshiriq uchun to‘qson daqiqa, o‘qish uchun oltmish daqiqa. Lug‘at yo‘q, telefon yo‘q, tanaffus yo‘q: xuddi imtihon kunidagidek.

scenes.title: Yozish: vaqt taqsimoti
board: Task 1 (40 min): read & plan 10 → write 25 → check 5
Task 2 (50 min): plan 10 → write 32 → check 8
Write the stop times at the top of the page.
scenes.say_native: Vaqtni oldindan, qog‘ozda taqsimlang. Birinchi topshiriqqa qirq daqiqa: o‘n daqiqa o‘qish va reja, yigirma besh daqiqa yozish, besh daqiqa tekshirish. Ikkinchisiga ellik daqiqa. Eng muhim odat: varaqning tepasiga to‘xtash vaqtlarini yozing, masalan, “10:40 — birinchi topshiriq tugaydi”. Shunda vaqtni his-tuyg‘u bilan emas, soat bilan boshqarasiz.
scenes.say: Divide the time before you write a single word, and write your stop times at the top of the page. The clock decides, not your feelings.
scenes.say_uz: Bitta so‘z yozishdan oldin vaqtni bo‘ling va to‘xtash vaqtlarini varaq tepasiga yozing. Soat hal qiladi, his-tuyg‘ularingiz emas.

scenes.title: O‘n daqiqalik reja
board: 1 Position (thesis) in one sentence
2 One idea per paragraph + example
3 Counter-argument and response
4 Conclusion that answers the question

examples.t: Thesis: Remote work benefits experienced staff but risks isolating newcomers.
examples.uz: Tezis: Masofaviy ish tajribali xodimlarga foydali, lekin yangi xodimlarni yolg‘izlatib qo‘yishi mumkin.

scenes.say_native: Reja to‘liq gaplardan iborat bo‘lmaydi. Avval bitta gapda pozitsiyangizni yozing, bu tezis. Keyin har bir xatboshi uchun bitta g‘oya va bitta misol. Uchinchi qadam: qarshi fikr va unga javob. Oxirida savolga to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri javob beradigan xulosa. Inglizcha akademik matnda pozitsiya boshidanoq aniq bo‘lishi kerak, o‘zbek maktab inshosidagidek asta-sekin ochilmaydi.
scenes.say: One sentence for your position. One idea and one example per paragraph. A counter-argument, and your answer to it. Then stop planning and start writing.
scenes.say_uz: Pozitsiyangiz uchun bitta gap. Har xatboshiga bitta g‘oya va bitta misol. Qarshi fikr va unga javobingiz. Keyin rejalashni to‘xtatib, yozishni boshlang.

scenes.title: Xato: bir topshiriqqa butun vaqt
board: ✗ Task 1: 65 min (perfect)  →  Task 2: 25 min (unfinished)
✓ Task 1: 40 min (good)  →  Task 2: 50 min (good)
Two good answers > one perfect + one weak
scenes.say_native: Eng qimmatga tushadigan xato: birinchi topshiriqni mukammal qilish uchun vaqtni cho‘zish. Natijada ikkinchi topshiriq shoshilinch yoziladi, so‘z soni yetmaydi yoki xulosa yo‘q. Ballar ikki topshiriqqa taqsimlanadi, shuning uchun ikkita yaxshi javob bitta mukammal va bitta chala javobdan doim ustun. Belgilangan vaqt tugadimi, gapni tugating va keyingisiga o‘ting.
scenes.say: Two good answers will always beat one perfect answer and one unfinished one. When your stop time comes, finish the sentence and move on.
scenes.say_uz: Ikkita yaxshi javob doim bitta mukammal va bitta chala javobdan ustun. To‘xtash vaqti kelganda gapni tugating va keyingisiga o‘ting.

scenes.title: Reja tuzing: 2 daqiqa
board: Prompt: 'Cities should ban private cars from their centres.'
Write: thesis + 3 paragraph ideas + counter-argument
Keywords only!
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Doskadagi mavzu bo‘yicha tezkor reja tuzing: bitta gapli tezis, uchta xatboshi g‘oyasi va bitta qarshi fikr. Faqat kalit so‘zlar yozing. Haqiqiy imtihonda bunga o‘n daqiqa bor, lekin hozir ikki daqiqada sinab ko‘ring, darsni to‘xtatib turing. Bu tezlik mashqi.
scenes.say: Cities should ban private cars from their centres. Plan it now: a thesis, three paragraph ideas and a counter-argument.
scenes.say_uz: Shaharlar o‘z markazlarida shaxsiy avtomobillarni taqiqlashi kerak. Hozir rejalang: tezis, uchta xatboshi g‘oyasi va qarshi fikr.

scenes.title: Javob: namuna reja
board: Thesis: a ban works only with strong public transport
P1 air & health  P2 space for people  P3 local trade
Counter: disabled & elderly access → exemptions
Conclusion: phased ban, not overnight
scenes.say_native: Namuna rejaga qarang. Tezis oddiy “ha” yoki “yo‘q” emas, shartli pozitsiya: taqiq faqat kuchli jamoat transporti bilan ishlaydi. Xatboshilar: havo va sog‘liq, odamlar uchun makon, mahalliy savdo. Qarshi fikr: nogironligi bor va keksa odamlarning kirishi, javob esa istisnolar. Xulosa: bosqichma-bosqich taqiq. C2 darajada aynan shunday nozik pozitsiya kutiladi.
scenes.say: Notice the thesis is conditional, not simply yes or no. A ban works only if public transport is strong. That nuance is what C2 examiners look for.
scenes.say_uz: E’tibor bering, tezis shunchaki ha yoki yo‘q emas, shartli. Taqiq faqat jamoat transporti kuchli bo‘lsa ishlaydi. C2 imtihonchilari aynan shu nozikligni qidiradi.

scenes.title: Birinchi topshiriq: ikki matn
board: Summarise the key point of EACH text
Evaluate: Do you agree? Why?
Paraphrase — never copy phrases
Text A argues that... whereas Text B contends...
scenes.say_native: Birinchi topshiriqda sizga ikki qisqa matn beriladi. Vazifa uchta: har bir matnning asosiy fikrini qisqa bayon qilish, ularni baholash va o‘z fikringizni qo‘shish. Asosiy qoida: matndan iboralarni ko‘chirmang, o‘z so‘zlaringiz bilan qayta ifodalang. Ikki matnni “whereas”, “by contrast”, “Text B takes a more sceptical view” kabi iboralar bilan solishtiring.
scenes.say: Summarise each text, evaluate both, and add your own view. And paraphrase: an examiner can spot copied phrases instantly.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir matnni qisqa bayon qiling, ikkalasini baholang va o‘z fikringizni qo‘shing. Va qayta ifodalang: imtihonchi ko‘chirilgan iboralarni darhol sezadi.

scenes.title: Namuna xatboshi
board: summarise A → contrast B → evaluate
whereas / takes a more sceptical view / persuasive as far as it goes
scenes.say_native: Namuna xatboshini tinglang. Unda uch harakat bor: birinchi matn qisqa bayon qilinadi, ikkinchi matn unga qarama-qarshi qo‘yiladi va oxirida baholash beriladi. “Persuasive as far as it goes” iborasi “ma’lum darajada ishonarli” degani, bu nozik baholash. E’tibor bering, matnlardagi so‘zlar takrorlanmagan.
scenes.say: The first text maintains that green spaces make city dwellers measurably calmer, whereas the second takes a more sceptical view, warning that councils routinely underestimate what such spaces cost to maintain. The first argument is persuasive as far as it goes, but it ignores who pays.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi matnda yashil maydonlar shahar aholisini sezilarli darajada tinchroq qilishi ta’kidlanadi, ikkinchisi esa shubhaliroq qarashni olib, kengashlar bunday maydonlarni saqlash narxini muntazam kam baholashidan ogohlantiradi. Birinchi dalil ma’lum darajada ishonarli, lekin kim to‘lashini e’tiborsiz qoldiradi.

scenes.title: Xato: ko‘chirish va ro‘yxat
board: ✗ Text A says 'urban green spaces have been shown to reduce stress levels'.
✓ According to Text A, parks seem to make city life less stressful.
✗ Text A says... Text B says... (no evaluation)
scenes.say_native: Ikki tipik xato. Birinchisi: matndan butun iborani ko‘chirish. Bu til bilimini ko‘rsatmaydi va baholanmaydi. Ikkinchisi: “Text A says, Text B says” deb ro‘yxat qilish, lekin baholamaslik. Bu topshiriqning yarmini bajarish demak. O‘zbek maktabida iqtibos keltirish hurmat belgisi, inglizcha imtihonda esa mahorat qayta ifodalashda ko‘rinadi.
scenes.say: Copying phrases from the texts shows nothing about your English. And listing what each text says without evaluating it is only half the task.
scenes.say_uz: Matndan iboralarni ko‘chirish ingliz tilingiz haqida hech narsa ko‘rsatmaydi. Har bir matn nima deyishini baholamasdan sanab chiqish esa topshiriqning yarmi, xolos.

scenes.title: Qayta ifodalang
board: 1 Urban green spaces have been shown to reduce stress levels among residents.
2 The cost of maintaining such spaces is frequently underestimated by local authorities.
Paraphrase both — change words AND structure.
scenes.say_native: Ikki gapni o‘z so‘zlaringiz bilan qayta yozing. Faqat sinonim qo‘yish yetarli emas, tuzilmani ham o‘zgartiring: majhul nisbatni faol qiling, otni fe’lga aylantiring. Masalan, “maintaining” o‘rniga “upkeep”, “local authorities” o‘rniga “councils” ishlatish mumkin. Lekin ma’no aynan saqlanishi kerak.
scenes.say: Paraphrase both sentences. Change the vocabulary and the structure, but keep the meaning exactly.
scenes.say_uz: Ikkala gapni qayta ifodalang. Lug‘at va tuzilmani o‘zgartiring, lekin ma’noni aynan saqlang.

scenes.title: Javob: qayta ifoda
board: 1 Research suggests that city parks lower residents' stress.
2 Councils often fail to anticipate how expensive upkeep can be.
passive → active; noun → verb; shown → suggests
scenes.say_native: Namunalar. Birinchi gapda majhul “have been shown” faol “research suggests” ga aylandi, “urban green spaces” esa “city parks” bo‘ldi. Ikkinchi gapda “is frequently underestimated” o‘rniga “often fail to anticipate” fe’l tuzilmasi ishlatildi va “cost of maintaining” “how expensive upkeep can be” ga aylandi.
scenes.say: Research suggests that city parks lower residents' stress. Councils often fail to anticipate how expensive upkeep can be.
scenes.say_uz: Tadqiqotlar shahar bog‘lari aholining stressini kamaytirishini ko‘rsatadi. Kengashlar ko‘pincha saqlash qanchalik qimmatga tushishini oldindan ko‘ra olmaydi.

scenes.title: Tinglash 1: mockdan keyin
board: Listening 1: two candidates after the writing mock
Listen for: time, decisions, reasons
scenes.say_native: Birinchi tinglash. Ikki nomzod yozish mock imtihonidan keyin gaplashyapti. Ulardan biri vaqtni yaxshi boshqargan, ikkinchisi esa yo‘q. Kim qanday qaror qilgani va nima sababdan, shunga e’tibor bering. Dialogdan keyin uchta savol beriladi. Lauraning ohangiga ham e’tibor bering: u o‘zidan noroziligini qanday iboralar bilan bildiradi? Bu ham tabiiy nutq namunasi.
scenes.say: Aziz: How did you get on? Laura: Not great, to be honest. I spent nearly an hour on the essay, so the article was a real rush. I didn't even get round to checking it. Aziz: Ouch. I made myself stop at forty minutes, even though my conclusion was only two lines. Laura: Didn't that bother you? Aziz: Less than an unfinished second task would have. Half a page of conclusion isn't worth a blank page somewhere else.
scenes.say_uz: Aziz: Qalay o‘tdi? Laura: Rostini aytsam, yaxshi emas. Essega deyarli bir soat sarfladim, maqola esa juda shoshilinch bo‘ldi. Hatto tekshirishga ham qo‘lim tegmadi. Aziz: Voy. Men qirq daqiqada o‘zimni to‘xtatdim, garchi xulosam atigi ikki qator bo‘lsa ham. Laura: Bu seni bezovta qilmadimi? Aziz: Chala ikkinchi topshiriqchalik emas. Yarim sahifalik xulosa boshqa joydagi bo‘sh sahifaga arzimaydi.

scenes.title: Tinglash 1: savollar
board: 1 Why was Laura's article rushed?
2 What rule did Aziz follow?
3 Why does he think it was the right choice?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: nega Lauraning maqolasi shoshilinch bo‘ldi? Ikkinchi: Aziz qanday qoidaga amal qildi? Uchinchi: u nega buni to‘g‘ri tanlov deb hisoblaydi? Javoblarni bitta gap bilan, iloji bo‘lsa o‘z so‘zlaringiz bilan yozing. Bu ham qayta ifodalash mashqi.
scenes.say: Why was Laura's article rushed? What rule did Aziz follow? And why does he think he made the right choice?
scenes.say_uz: Nega Lauraning maqolasi shoshilinch bo‘ldi? Aziz qanday qoidaga amal qildi? Va u nega to‘g‘ri tanlov qildim deb o‘ylaydi?

scenes.title: Tinglash 1: javoblar
board: 1 She spent nearly an hour on the essay.
2 He stopped Task 1 at 40 minutes.
3 A short conclusion costs less than an unfinished task.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: Laura essega deyarli bir soat sarflagan. Ikkinchi: Aziz birinchi topshiriqni qirq daqiqada to‘xtatgan, xulosa qisqa bo‘lsa ham. Uchinchi: qisqa xulosa chala ikkinchi topshiriqdan kamroq ball yo‘qotadi. “Get round to” frazali fe’liga ham e’tibor bering: “nihoyat qo‘l tegmoq”, amerikancha “get around to”.
scenes.say: She spent almost an hour on the essay. He stopped at forty minutes. A short conclusion costs far less than an unfinished task.
scenes.say_uz: U essega deyarli bir soat sarfladi. U qirq daqiqada to‘xtadi. Qisqa xulosa chala topshiriqdan ancha kam ball yo‘qotadi.

scenes.title: O‘qish: eng qiyin savol turlari
board: 1 Gapped text: missing paragraphs
2 Inference & attitude (multiple choice)
3 Cross-text matching: who agrees with whom?
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘qishga o‘tamiz. C2 darajasida eng ko‘p ball yo‘qotiladigan uch savol turi bor. Birinchisi: tushirib qoldirilgan xatboshilarni joyiga qo‘yish. Ikkinchisi: yozuvchining munosabati yoki yashirin ma’nosi haqidagi test savollari. Uchinchisi: bir necha matn mualliflarining fikrlarini solishtirish. Har birining o‘z strategiyasi bor va ularni birma-bir ko‘rib chiqamiz.
scenes.say: Three question types cost candidates the most marks at this level: gapped texts, inference and attitude questions, and cross-text matching.
scenes.say_uz: Bu darajada nomzodlarga eng ko‘p ball yo‘qotadigan uch savol turi: bo‘sh joyli matnlar, xulosa va munosabat savollari hamda matnlararo moslashtirish.

scenes.title: Bo‘sh joyli matn: bog‘lanish izlari
board: Look BEFORE and AFTER the gap
Reference: this, such, the latter, she, it
Linkers: however, nevertheless, by then
Topic alone is NOT enough
scenes.say_native: Bo‘sh joyli matnda mavzu bo‘yicha mos keladigan xatboshilar ko‘p bo‘ladi, shuning uchun mavzu yetarli emas. Sizga grammatik va mantiqiy izlar kerak. Bo‘shliqdan oldingi va keyingi gaplarga qarang. “This”, “such”, “the latter”, “she” nimaga ishora qiladi? “However” qanday qarama-qarshilikni talab qiladi? To‘g‘ri xatboshi ikki tomondan ham mos tushishi shart.
scenes.say: Don't match by topic; match by links. Every this, such, the latter or however points somewhere. The right paragraph fits on both sides of the gap.
scenes.say_uz: Mavzu bo‘yicha emas, bog‘lanish bo‘yicha moslang. Har bir this, such, the latter yoki however biror joyga ishora qiladi. To‘g‘ri xatboshi bo‘shliqning ikki tomoniga ham mos keladi.

scenes.title: Bo‘shliqni to‘ldiring
board: Many cities have now restricted cars in their centres. [ GAP ] The latter, however, proved far more controversial.
A Some did so overnight; others introduced charges gradually.
B Shopkeepers in these areas welcomed the move with enthusiasm.
scenes.say_native: Mini mashq. Bo‘shliqqa A yoki B variantini qo‘ying. Ikkalasi ham mavzuga mos. Hal qiluvchi iz bo‘shliqdan keyingi gapda turibdi. “The latter” so‘zi nimani talab qiladi? Javobni asoslab bering. Avval o‘zingiz qaror qiling, keyin javobni tekshiramiz. Qaysi so‘z sizga yordam berganini ham yozib qo‘ying.
scenes.say: Many cities have now restricted cars in their centres. Gap. The latter, however, proved far more controversial. Which option fits, A or B, and why?
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘p shaharlar markazlarida avtomobillarni chekladi. Bo‘shliq. Biroq, ikkinchisi ancha bahsli bo‘lib chiqdi. Qaysi variant mos, A yoki B, va nega?

scenes.title: Javob: A
board: A ✓ two options → 'the latter' = gradual charges
B ✗ no pair of things for 'the latter'
'however' → contrast with the first option
scenes.say_native: To‘g‘ri javob A. “The latter” ikki narsadan ikkinchisini bildiradi, demak oldingi gapda aynan ikki variant bo‘lishi kerak. A da ular bor: birdaniga taqiqlash va asta-sekin to‘lov joriy qilish. “The latter”, ya’ni to‘lovlar, bahsliroq bo‘lgan. B mavzuga mos, lekin unda juftlik yo‘q va “however” uchun qarama-qarshilik ham yo‘q.
scenes.say: A is correct. The latter needs two things, and A gives two: overnight bans and gradual charges. B fits the topic but not the grammar of the text.
scenes.say_uz: A to‘g‘ri. The latter ikki narsani talab qiladi va A ikkitasini beradi: birdaniga taqiq va asta-sekin to‘lovlar. B mavzuga mos, lekin matn grammatikasiga emas.

scenes.title: Munosabat va xulosa savollari
board: Answer the question asked, not a true fact
Watch tone words: yet, admittedly, undeniably, nagging
Distractors: same words, wrong meaning
scenes.say_native: Munosabat savollarida javob matnda ochiq yozilmaydi, uni ohang so‘zlaridan topasiz: “yet”, “admittedly”, “undeniably”, “nagging”. Chalg‘ituvchi variantlar odatda ikki xil bo‘ladi. Birinchisi: matnda bor fakt, lekin savolga javob emas. Ikkinchisi: matndagi so‘zlarni takrorlaydi, lekin ma’noni buzadi. To‘g‘ri javob ko‘pincha matndagi so‘zlarni emas, ma’noni beradi.
scenes.say: The right option usually paraphrases the meaning. The wrong ones often repeat the exact words of the text, or state something true that does not answer the question.
scenes.say_uz: To‘g‘ri variant odatda ma’noni qayta ifodalaydi. Noto‘g‘rilari ko‘pincha matndagi so‘zlarni aynan takrorlaydi yoki savolga javob bo‘lmagan to‘g‘ri gapni aytadi.

scenes.title: Xato: so‘z mosligi tuzog‘i
board: Text: '...hailed as a masterpiece...'
✗ Option: 'The writer agrees it is a masterpiece.' (same word!)
✓ Check what the WRITER thinks, not what critics say
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek o‘quvchilari ko‘p tushadigan tuzoq: matndagi so‘zni variantda ko‘rib, uni darhol tanlash. Agar matnda “hailed as a masterpiece” bo‘lsa, “the writer agrees it is a masterpiece” varianti juda jozibali ko‘rinadi. Lekin kim maqtadi? Tanqidchilar. Yozuvchi esa boshqacha o‘ylashi mumkin. Har doim so‘rang: bu fikr kimniki?
scenes.say: Seeing the same word in the text and in an option is not evidence; it is usually bait. Always ask whose opinion it is.
scenes.say_uz: Matnda va variantda bir xil so‘zni ko‘rish dalil emas, ko‘pincha bu qopqon. Har doim bu kimning fikri ekanini so‘rang.

scenes.title: Munosabat savoli
board: What is the writer's attitude to the novel?
A She agrees with critics that it is a masterpiece.
B She admires its style but doubts its depth.
C She found the prose clumsy.  D She didn't finish it.
scenes.say_native: Qisqa parchani tinglang va yozuvchining romanga munosabatini aniqlang. Ohang so‘zlariga quloq soling: “undeniably”, “yet”, “nagging”. To‘rt variantdan qaysi biri ma’noni beradi, qaysilari so‘z tuzog‘i? Kerak bo‘lsa, parchani qayta tinglang. Variantlarni o‘qishdan oldin parchaning o‘zidan yozuvchining fikrini bir jumla bilan yozib oling.
scenes.say: Critics have hailed the novel as a masterpiece, and its prose is undeniably elegant. Yet I finished it with the nagging sense that elegance had been mistaken for depth.
scenes.say_uz: Tanqidchilar romanni durdona deb olqishladi va uning nasri shubhasiz nafis. Biroq men uni nafislik chuqurlik deb adashtirilgan degan tinch qo‘ymaydigan tuyg‘u bilan o‘qib tugatdim.

scenes.title: Javob: B
board: B ✓ elegant prose (style) + mistaken for depth (doubt)
A ✗ critics' view, not hers
C ✗ opposite: 'undeniably elegant'
D ✗ 'I finished it'
scenes.say_native: To‘g‘ri javob B. “Undeniably elegant” uslubni tan olishni, “elegance had been mistaken for depth” esa chuqurlikka shubhani bildiradi. A — tanqidchilar fikri, yozuvchiniki emas. C teskari: nasr nafis deyilgan. D “finished” so‘zidan foydalangan tuzoq: yozuvchi kitobni tugatgan. Uchta chalg‘ituvchining hammasi matndagi so‘zlarga tayangan.
scenes.say: B. She praises the style but doubts the substance. A is the critics' view, C contradicts the text, and D twists the word finished.
scenes.say_uz: B. U uslubni maqtaydi, lekin mazmunga shubha qiladi. A tanqidchilar fikri, C matnga zid, D esa finished so‘zini buzib ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.title: Matnlararo moslashtirish
board: Summarise each writer's view in 5 words
in the margin, before reading the questions
Q: Which writer shares A's view on...?
scenes.say_native: Matnlararo savollarda bir necha muallif bir mavzuda fikr bildiradi va siz kim kim bilan rozi yoki rozi emasligini topasiz. Strategiya: savollarni o‘qishdan oldin har bir muallifning fikrini chetga besh so‘z bilan yozing. Shunda savol kelganda butun matnni qayta o‘qimaysiz, qaydlaringizga qaraysiz. Bu vaqtni sezilarli tejaydi.
scenes.say: Before you read the questions, write each writer's position in the margin in about five words. Then compare your notes, not whole texts.
scenes.say_uz: Savollarni o‘qishdan oldin har bir muallif pozitsiyasini chetga taxminan besh so‘z bilan yozing. Keyin butun matnlarni emas, qaydlaringizni solishtiring.

scenes.title: Kim kim bilan rozi?
board: A: Remote work boosts productivity, but only for experienced staff.
B: Juniors lose most when offices empty; they learn by overhearing.
C: The data on remote productivity is too inconsistent for firm conclusions.
1 Who shares A's concern about newcomers?  2 Who questions the evidence itself?
scenes.say_native: Uch muallifning qisqa fikri doskada. Avval har biri uchun besh so‘zlik qayd yozing. Keyin ikki savolga javob bering. Birinchi: kim A muallif bilan tajribasiz xodimlar haqidagi xavotirni baham ko‘radi? Ikkinchi: kim dalillarning o‘zini shubha ostiga oladi? Ehtiyot bo‘ling: A ning fikri ikki qismdan iborat.
scenes.say: Which writer shares A's concern about less experienced staff? And which writer questions the evidence itself?
scenes.say_uz: Qaysi muallif A ning tajribasiz xodimlar haqidagi xavotirini baham ko‘radi? Qaysi muallif dalillarning o‘zini shubha ostiga oladi?

scenes.title: Javob: B va C
board: 1 B — 'juniors lose most' = 'only for experienced staff'
2 C — 'too inconsistent' = questions the data
Notes: A = good for seniors only; B = juniors suffer; C = data unclear
scenes.say_native: Birinchi savolga javob B. A “faqat tajribalilar uchun” deydi, ya’ni yangi xodimlarga foyda yo‘q. B “juniors lose most” deydi, bu bir xil xavotir, lekin boshqa so‘zlar bilan. Ikkinchi savolga javob C: u ma’lumotlar xulosa uchun juda nomuvofiq deydi. Qaydlar doskada: A — faqat tajribalilar uchun foydali; B — yangilar zarar ko‘radi; C — ma’lumot noaniq.
scenes.say: B shares A's concern, in completely different words. C questions the data itself. Matching meanings, not words, is the whole skill.
scenes.say_uz: B A ning xavotirini butunlay boshqa so‘zlar bilan baham ko‘radi. C ma’lumotning o‘zini shubha ostiga oladi. So‘zlarni emas, ma’nolarni moslash, mana butun ko‘nikma.

scenes.title: Yozishni baholash: to‘rt mezon
board: Content: all points covered, relevant
Communicative achievement: right register & effect on reader
Organisation: paragraphs, cohesion
Language: range + accuracy  (each 0–5)
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘z-o‘zini baholash. Ko‘plab imtihonlarda yozma ish to‘rt mezon bo‘yicha baholanadi. Mazmun: topshiriqdagi barcha nuqtalar yoritilganmi? Kommunikativ maqsad: uslub o‘quvchiga mosmi, maqola maqolaga, hisobot hisobotga o‘xshaydimi? Tuzilish: xatboshilar va bog‘lanish. Til: xilma-xillik va aniqlik. Har biriga noldan beshgacha ball qo‘ying.
scenes.say: Content, communicative achievement, organisation and language. Score each from zero to five, and justify each score with a line from your own text.
scenes.say_uz: Mazmun, kommunikativ maqsad, tuzilish va til. Har biriga noldan beshgacha ball qo‘ying va har bir ballni o‘z matningizdan bir satr bilan asoslang.

scenes.title: O‘qishni baholash: savol turi bo‘yicha
board: Don't just count: 41/50
Sort errors by question type
Ask why: vocabulary? trap? timing?
scenes.say_native: O‘qishda umumiy ballni sanash yetarli emas. Xatolarni savol turi bo‘yicha guruhlang: bo‘sh joyli matnda nechta, munosabat savollarida nechta, moslashtirishda nechta. Keyin har bir xato uchun sababni yozing: notanish so‘z, so‘z tuzog‘i yoki vaqt yetmadi. Ana shunda nimani mashq qilishni aniq bilasiz.
scenes.say: A total score tells you how you did; a breakdown by question type tells you what to do next. Note the reason behind every wrong answer.
scenes.say_uz: Umumiy ball qanday natija qilganingizni aytadi, savol turlari bo‘yicha taqsimot esa keyin nima qilishni aytadi. Har bir noto‘g‘ri javob sababini yozing.

scenes.title: Tinglash 2: o‘qituvchi fikri
board: Listening 2: feedback on a mock
Listen for: lost marks, reasons, advice
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi tinglash. O‘qituvchi talabaga mock natijalari bo‘yicha fikr bildiryapti. Talaba qayerda ball yo‘qotdi, nima sababdan va o‘qituvchi qanday maslahat berdi, shularga e’tibor bering. Dialog tabiiy tezlikda, shuning uchun qisqargan shakllarga ham quloq soling.
scenes.say: Teacher: Your reading was solid, but you dropped four marks on the gapped text. Student: I know. I kept picking paragraphs that matched the topic. Teacher: Exactly. You should've checked the links: what does this refer to, who's she? Student: And the essay? Teacher: Strong language, but your second paragraph just repeats the first. I'd give organisation a three. Student: So, fewer ideas, better developed? Teacher: Precisely.
scenes.say_uz: O‘qituvchi: O‘qishingiz yaxshi, lekin bo‘sh joyli matnda to‘rt ball yo‘qotdingiz. Talaba: Bilaman. Mavzuga mos xatboshilarni tanlayverdim. O‘qituvchi: Aynan. Bog‘lanishlarni tekshirishingiz kerak edi: this nimaga ishora qiladi, she kim? Talaba: Esse-chi? O‘qituvchi: Til kuchli, lekin ikkinchi xatboshi birinchisini takrorlaydi. Tuzilishga uch qo‘ygan bo‘lardim. Talaba: Demak, kamroq g‘oya, lekin yaxshiroq rivojlantirilgan? O‘qituvchi: Aynan.

scenes.title: Tinglash 2: savollar
board: 1 Why did the student lose marks on the gapped text?
2 What should she have checked?
3 What is the problem with her essay?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi: talaba nega bo‘sh joyli matnda ball yo‘qotdi? Ikkinchi: u nimani tekshirishi kerak edi? Uchinchi: essesida qanday muammo bor va qaysi mezonga ta’sir qildi? Javoblarni bugungi darsdagi atamalar bilan yozishga harakat qiling. Javoblaringizni yozib qo‘ying, keyin tekshiramiz.
scenes.say: Why did she lose marks on the gapped text? What should she have checked? And what is wrong with her essay?
scenes.say_uz: U bo‘sh joyli matnda nega ball yo‘qotdi? Nimani tekshirishi kerak edi? Va essesida nima muammo?

scenes.title: Tinglash 2: javoblar
board: 1 She matched by topic, not by links.
2 Reference words: this, she.
3 Paragraph 2 repeats paragraph 1 → Organisation 3/5
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: u xatboshilarni mavzu bo‘yicha tanlagan, bog‘lanish bo‘yicha emas, bu biz ko‘rgan xato. Ikkinchi: “this” va “she” kabi ishora so‘zlarini tekshirishi kerak edi. Uchinchi: ikkinchi xatboshi birinchisini takrorlaydi, shuning uchun tuzilishga uch ball. O‘qituvchining maslahati ham muhim: g‘oyalar kamroq, lekin chuqurroq rivojlantirilgan bo‘lsin.
scenes.say: She matched by topic. She should've checked reference words. And her essay repeated itself, which cost her marks for organisation.
scenes.say_uz: U mavzu bo‘yicha moslagan. Ishora so‘zlarini tekshirishi kerak edi. Essesi esa o‘zini takrorlagan va bu tuzilish uchun ball yo‘qotdi.

scenes.title: Tabiiy nutq: should've
board: should've /ˈʃʊdəv/  would've /ˈwʊdəv/  could've /ˈkʊdəv/
✗ should of (writing error!)
✓ should have / should've
scenes.say_native: Dialogda o‘qituvchi “should’ve” dedi. Tabiiy nutqda “have” kuchsiz shaklga o‘tadi va “ʃʊdəv” deb eshitiladi. Shuning uchun hatto ona tilida so‘zlashuvchilar ham ba’zan “should of” deb yozib qo‘yadi. Bu yozuvda jiddiy xato. Esse va maqolada to‘liq “should have” yozing, “should’ve” esa norasmiy matnlar uchun. Bu tinglash va yozish bir-biriga qanday bog‘liqligining yaxshi misoli.
scenes.say: You should've checked the links. In speech, have becomes a tiny /əv/, which is why some people wrongly write should of. In an essay, write should have in full.
scenes.say_uz: Bog‘lanishlarni tekshirishingiz kerak edi. Nutqda have kichik /əv/ ga aylanadi, shuning uchun ba’zilar noto‘g‘ri should of deb yozadi. Esseda should have ni to‘liq yozing.

scenes.title: Xatboshini baholang
board: Nowadays technology is very important in our life. There are many advantages and disadvantages.
Firstly, technology help people to communicate. Secondly, it is bad for health.
In conclusion, technology has good and bad sides.
Score: Content / Organisation / Language (0–5). Find 4 problems.
scenes.say_native: Endi siz imtihonchisiz. Doskadagi xatboshini o‘qing va uni mazmun, tuzilish va til bo‘yicha noldan beshgacha baholang. Kamida to‘rtta aniq muammoni toping, ulardan biri grammatik. Har bir ballni matndan iqtibos bilan asoslang. Bu sizning o‘z ishingizni baholash uchun mashq.
scenes.say: Read the paragraph and score it for content, organisation and language. Find at least four specific problems, including one grammar error.
scenes.say_uz: Xatboshini o‘qing va uni mazmun, tuzilish va til bo‘yicha baholang. Kamida to‘rtta aniq muammoni toping, shu jumladan bitta grammatik xato.

scenes.title: Javob: baholash
board: 1 Clichéd opening: 'Nowadays... very important'
2 No examples or development
3 ✗ technology help → ✓ technology helps
4 Mechanical linkers; conclusion inside a paragraph  → ~1–2 / 5
scenes.say_native: Muammolar. Birinchi: “Nowadays technology is very important” — siyqasi chiqqan, hech narsa demaydigan boshlanish. Ikkinchi: birorta misol yoki rivojlantirish yo‘q. Uchinchi: “technology help” — mos kelish xatosi, to‘g‘risi “helps”. To‘rtinchi: “firstly, secondly, in conclusion” mexanik, xulosa esa bitta xatboshi ichida. C2 shkalasida har bir mezon taxminan bir-ikki ball.
scenes.say: A clichéd opening, no development, an agreement error, and mechanical linkers. On a C2 scale, this would score around one or two on each criterion.
scenes.say_uz: Siyqasi chiqqan boshlanish, rivojlantirish yo‘q, moslik xatosi va mexanik bog‘lovchilar. C2 shkalasida bu har bir mezon bo‘yicha taxminan bir yoki ikki ball oladi.

scenes.title: Natijadan rejaga
board: 1 Find your weakest area (lowest score)
2 Find the cause (skill? knowledge? time?)
3 One daily drill + one weekly mock
4 Re-measure in 2 weeks
scenes.say_native: Endi rivojlanish rejasi. Natijalaringizdan eng zaif sohani toping, bu eng past ball. Keyin sababni aniqlang: ko‘nikma yetishmaydimi, bilim yetishmaydimi yoki vaqtmi? Har bir sabab boshqa davoni talab qiladi. Rejada ikki narsa bo‘lsin: kundalik qisqa mashq va haftalik to‘liq mock. Ikki haftadan keyin xuddi shu o‘lchov bilan qayta tekshiring.
scenes.say: Weakest area, real cause, daily drill, weekly mock, and a re-test in two weeks. A plan without a re-test is just hope.
scenes.say_uz: Eng zaif soha, haqiqiy sabab, kundalik mashq, haftalik mock va ikki haftadan keyin qayta tekshiruv. Qayta tekshiruvsiz reja shunchaki umid.

scenes.title: Xato: “ko‘proq o‘qiyman”
board: ✗ I'll read more and write more.
✓ Gapped text 3/7 → daily: one gapped text, circle every reference word before choosing.
Target: 5/7 in two weeks.
scenes.say_native: “Ko‘proq o‘qiyman, ko‘proq yozaman” — bu reja emas, chunki u sababga qaratilmagan. Agar bo‘sh joyli matnda yettidan uchta to‘g‘ri bo‘lsa, muammo umumiy o‘qishda emas, bog‘lanish izlarini ko‘rmaslikda. Demak, davo aniq: har kuni bitta shunday matn, tanlashdan oldin har bir ishora so‘zini aylana ichiga olish. Maqsad: ikki haftada yettidan besh.
scenes.say: Read more is not a plan. If you scored three out of seven on gapped texts, drill exactly that: one text a day, circling every reference word before you choose.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘proq o‘qiyman reja emas. Agar bo‘sh joyli matnda yettidan uch olgan bo‘lsangiz, aynan shuni mashq qiling: kuniga bitta matn, tanlashdan oldin har bir ishora so‘zini aylana ichiga oling.

scenes.title: Rejani tuzing
board: Results: Gapped text 3/7 · Inference 4/6 · Cross-text 4/4
Writing: Content 4 · Comm. ach. 3 · Organisation 3 · Language 4
Task 2 unfinished (ran out of time)
Write a 3-point plan with numbers.
scenes.say_native: Doskada bir nomzodning natijalari. Uch bandli reja tuzing. Avval eng zaif uch sohani toping, keyin har biri uchun sabab, kundalik mashq va o‘lchanadigan maqsad yozing. Ishora: bitta muammo bilim haqida emas, vaqt haqida. Qaysi soha mukammal va reja talab qilmaydi, buni ham ayting.
scenes.say: Here are one candidate's results. Write a three-point improvement plan, with a cause, a drill and a number for each point.
scenes.say_uz: Mana bir nomzodning natijalari. Uch bandli rivojlanish rejasini yozing, har bir band uchun sabab, mashq va son bilan.

scenes.title: Javob: namuna reja
board: 1 Timing: stop Task 1 at 40 min; 3 timed Task 2s/week
2 Gapped text: 1/day, circle links → target 5/7
3 Organisation: 1 topic sentence per paragraph, check repetition
Cross-text 4/4 → no action needed
scenes.say_native: Namuna. Birinchi band vaqt haqida: ikkinchi topshiriq tugamagan, demak birinchisida qirq daqiqada to‘xtash va haftasiga uchta vaqtli ikkinchi topshiriq. Ikkinchi band: bo‘sh joyli matn, kuniga bitta, maqsad yettidan besh. Uchinchi band: tuzilish, har xatboshida bitta mavzu gapi va takrorni tekshirish. Moslashtirish to‘rtdan to‘rt, unga vaqt sarflamang.
scenes.say: Fix the timing first, then the gapped text, then organisation. Cross-text matching is already perfect, so leave it alone. Invest where the marks are.
scenes.say_uz: Avval vaqtni, keyin bo‘sh joyli matnni, so‘ng tuzilishni tuzating. Matnlararo moslashtirish allaqachon mukammal, uni tinch qo‘ying. Ballar qayerda bo‘lsa, o‘sha yerga sarmoya qiling.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: vaqtli maqola
board: Task 2 (50 min, 280–320 words):
Article for a culture magazine:
'Is reading on screens changing the way we think?'
Plan 10 → write 32 → check 8
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy ijodiy topshiriq. Darsni to‘xtating, taymerni ellik daqiqaga qo‘ying va madaniyat jurnali uchun maqola yozing. Mavzu doskada. Maqola uslubiga e’tibor bering: o‘quvchiga murojaat, qiziqarli sarlavha, ritorik savol joiz. O‘n daqiqa reja, o‘ttiz ikki daqiqa yozish, sakkiz daqiqa tekshirish. Tugatgach, to‘rt mezon bo‘yicha o‘zingizni baholang.
scenes.say: Write an article for a culture magazine: is reading on screens changing the way we think? Fifty minutes, starting now.
scenes.say_uz: Madaniyat jurnali uchun maqola yozing: ekranda o‘qish fikrlashimizni o‘zgartiryaptimi? Ellik daqiqa, hozir boshlanadi.

scenes.title: Namuna boshlanish va tekshiruv
board: Title: Skimming Our Way to Shallow Thought?
Check: all parts of the question? register? paragraphs?
articles, agreement, verb patterns, word count

examples.t: When did you last read ten pages without glancing at a notification?
examples.uz: Oxirgi marta qachon bildirishnomaga qaramasdan o‘n sahifa o‘qigansiz?

scenes.say_native: Namunaviy boshlanishga qarang: sarlavha savol shaklida va birinchi gap o‘quvchiga to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri murojaat qiladi. Bu maqola uslubi, esse emas. Oxirgi sakkiz daqiqada ro‘yxat bo‘yicha tekshiring: savolning hamma qismiga javob berildimi, uslub to‘g‘rimi, xatboshilar aniqmi. Keyin o‘zbek o‘quvchilarining eng ko‘p xatolari: artikllar, mos kelish va fe’l modellari. Va so‘z soni.
scenes.say: When did you last read ten pages without glancing at a notification? An opening like that speaks to the reader directly, which is exactly what an article should do.
scenes.say_uz: Oxirgi marta qachon bildirishnomaga qaramasdan o‘n sahifa o‘qigansiz? Bunday boshlanish o‘quvchiga to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri murojaat qiladi va maqola aynan shunday bo‘lishi kerak.

scenes.title: Dars xulosasi
board: Writing: stop times, 10-min plan, paraphrase + evaluate
Reading: links, not topics; meaning, not words; notes per writer
Self-scoring: 4 criteria + errors by question type
Plan: weakest area → cause → drill → re-test
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Yozishda vaqtni oldindan bo‘lasiz, o‘n daqiqada reja tuzasiz, matnlarni qayta ifodalab baholaysiz. O‘qishda xatboshilarni bog‘lanish bo‘yicha, variantlarni ma’no bo‘yicha, mualliflarni qisqa qaydlar bo‘yicha solishtirasiz. Baholashda to‘rt mezon va savol turlari bo‘yicha tahlil. Rejada esa eng zaif soha, sabab, mashq va qayta tekshiruv.
scenes.say: Plan against the clock, match by links and meaning, score yourself with evidence, and fix the weakest area first.
scenes.say_uz: Soatga qarab rejalang, bog‘lanish va ma’no bo‘yicha moslang, o‘zingizni dalil bilan baholang va avval eng zaif sohani tuzating.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Homework: complete the writing and reading mock (90 + 60 min)
Success: 4 writing scores with quotes + reading errors by type + 3-point plan with numbers
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: yozish va o‘qish mock imtihonini to‘liq, vaqt bilan topshiring: yozishga to‘qson, o‘qishga oltmish daqiqa. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: yozma ishga to‘rt mezon bo‘yicha iqtibosli ballar qo‘yilgan, o‘qish xatolari savol turi va sababi bo‘yicha guruhlangan, hamda sonli uch bandli reja tuzilgan. Keyingi darsda imtihon kuni strategiyasi va psixologiyasini o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Complete the full writing and reading mock under timed conditions, score it with evidence, and write your three-point plan. Next time: exam-day strategy and psychology.
scenes.say_uz: Yozish va o‘qish mock imtihonini to‘liq, vaqt bilan bajaring, dalil bilan baholang va uch bandli rejangizni yozing. Keyingi safar: imtihon kuni strategiyasi va psixologiyasi.

homework_uz: Yozish (90 daqiqa, ikki topshiriq) va o‘qish (60 daqiqa) mock imtihonini to‘liq, vaqt bilan topshiring. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: yozma ish to‘rt mezon (mazmun, kommunikativ maqsad, tuzilish, til) bo‘yicha 0–5 ball bilan baholangan va har bir ball iqtibos bilan asoslangan; o‘qish xatolari savol turi va sababi bo‘yicha guruhlangan; eng zaif uch soha bo‘yicha sabab, kundalik mashq va sonli maqsadli reja yozilgan.

quiz.q: You have 90 minutes for two writing tasks. What is the best approach?
options: Perfect Task 1, then do what you can on Task 2
Set stop times for each task before you start
Start Task 2 first and never plan
quiz.why_uz: Vaqtni oldindan bo‘lib, to‘xtash vaqtlarini yozish ikki yaxshi javobni kafolatlaydi.

quiz.q: Which is the best paraphrase of 'The cost of maintaining such spaces is frequently underestimated by local authorities'?
options: The cost of maintaining such spaces is often underestimated by local authorities.
Councils often fail to anticipate how expensive upkeep can be.
Spaces are expensive and authorities are local.
quiz.why_uz: Yaxshi qayta ifoda so‘zlarni ham, tuzilmani ham o‘zgartiradi, ma’noni esa saqlaydi.

quiz.q: In a gapped text, the sentence after the gap starts 'The latter...'. What must the missing paragraph contain?
quiz.why_uz: “The latter” ikki narsadan ikkinchisini bildiradi, demak oldin aynan ikki narsa bo‘lishi kerak.

quiz.q: An option repeats an exact phrase from the text. What should you do?
options: Be suspicious and check whose view it is
quiz.why_uz: Matndagi so‘zni takrorlaydigan variant ko‘pincha tuzoq; fikr kimniki ekanini tekshiring.

quiz.q: 'Its prose is undeniably elegant. Yet I finished it with the nagging sense that elegance had been mistaken for depth.' The writer...
options: thinks the book is a masterpiece
admires the style but doubts the substance
quiz.why_uz: “Undeniably elegant” uslubni tan oladi, “yet... mistaken for depth” mazmunga shubhani bildiradi.

quiz.q: Which sentence is correct in a formal essay?
options: The council should of acted sooner.
The council should have acted sooner.
The council should has acted sooner.
quiz.why_uz: “Should of” — nutqdagi /əv/ ni noto‘g‘ri yozish; to‘g‘risi “should have”.

quiz.q: Which is NOT one of the four writing criteria used in this lesson?
quiz.why_uz: To‘rt mezon: mazmun, kommunikativ maqsad, tuzilish va til.

options: Technology are helping people to communicate.
quiz.why_uz: Birlikdagi “technology” bilan fe’l -s oladi: helps; “help someone (to) do” ikkala shakli ham mumkin.

quiz.q: A student scores 3/7 on gapped texts. Which plan is best?
options: One gapped text a day, circling reference words; target 5/7 in two weeks.
quiz.why_uz: Reja aniq sababga qaratilgan, kundalik va sonli maqsadga ega bo‘lishi kerak.

quiz.q: What is the most efficient strategy for cross-text matching?
options: Reread all texts for every question
Note each writer's view in about five words first
quiz.why_uz: Har bir muallif fikrini qisqa qayd qilish vaqtni tejaydi va ma’no bo‘yicha solishtirishga yordam beradi.
